title: Forty for Zisis Vergos, dyer. Ninth day
medium: Six lawful dyes on paper, hung from two pegs beside a west window. Shown at the ninth day of forty

stages.name: the chair, painted empty, in walnut
his coat on the back of it; the table, the cup, the water
the wall and the floor, painted round him
him, last, in the quick dyes: hung
